duration_s.principle: Standard artifact duration field consumed by adversarial verification.

fmax_mhz.principle: Real P&R timing output records whether the routed tile has a plausible clock margin on CCGM1A1.

gatemate_bitstream_flashed.principle: Bare bool -- the terminal-state gate; true only if openFPGALoader accepted the bitstream on the real board.

honest_verdict.principle: Self-declared terminal, partial, or blocked state lets the conductor separate real hardware progress from honest precondition failure.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares this as hardware_smoke so duration checks use the hardware boundary rather than live-LLM expectations.

lut_dff_utilization.principle: Real synthesis/P&R numbers anchor the n=16 tile to actual GateMate resources instead of a paper estimate.

preconditions_checked.principle: Records the toolchain and board-detect checks before fabrication, preventing exp1680-class hardware fabrication.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content-addressed hash of RTL, commands, tool evidence, bitstream, and flash outcome catches silent drift.

run_duration_s.principle: Real wall-clock duration makes the hardware flash round-trip auditable and catches zero-duration fabricated runs.

sample_timing_note.principle: Explains why sample_timing_us is null when the board can be flashed but the programmed design has no supported host-visible timing path.

sample_timing_us.principle: On-board energy-eval cycle timing is populated only if a real readback path exists; null prevents fabricated timing.

synth_pnr_pack_succeeded.principle: Bare bool -- the toolchain end-to-end produced a bitstream, separable from the flash step.

thermal_note.principle: GateMate is passively cooled, so the artifact must disclose that burst smoke results are not sustained-load thermal evidence.

lut_dff_utilization.principle: Real synthesis/P&R numbers anchor the n=16 tile to actual GateMate resources instead of a paper estimate.

    map_cells:

        clean
